messages:
maya-fin: FYI customer Horizon reported a large embed spike in APAC billing for 2026-03-02, they sent invoice redline. Claims ~950k duplicate embeds. Can data/eng confirm quickly?

ethan-eng: send org_id and sample request_ids, will run a quick distinct vs raw count.

linda-cs: org_id=horizon-prod. uploaded CSV to secure drive and emailed it to @ethan-eng. Customer wants provisional credit while we investigate.

rahul-data: ran quick counts on embed_events for horizon-prod between 2026-03-02T01:50 and 2026-03-02T04:00 UTC. Query: GROUP BY request_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1. Rough duplicate estimate ~972,140 extra rows.

ethan-eng: checking apac-proxy: spike of 502/503 at 02:10-02:50 UTC, lots of client retries. Example: [2026-03-02T02:12:03Z] proxy-a upstream=502 req=xyz attempt=1 ack=true then attempt=2 got 200. Looks like first upstream response errored while backend actually ingested. Our pipeline dedupe happens post-ingest.

billing-bot: created provisional credit FIN-2378 for $1,050 for horizon-prod period=2026-03-02 reason="apac proxy duplicate ingest" status=pending-approval.

maya-fin: propose provisional credit $1,050 while data runs full de-dupe+replay job. approve?

ethan-eng: approved from eng side. Note: we can dedupe on request_id+ack_id and replay; small risk of dropping legitimate client retry where first attempt never reached backend. But logs indicate majority are duplicates.

linda-cs: informed customer about provisional credit and ETA for final reconciliation (EOD Mon). Customer acknowledged.

rahul-data: starting full dedupe job now; ETA ~3.5h. Will post final distinct counts and reconciliation delta when complete.

maya-fin: thanks all, keep thread updated. Once final numbers in, we'll true-up next invoice or refund accordingly.
